defaults.video_script: Two goals in four minutes. Mbappe was only nineteen. Kazan, June two thousand and eighteen. France against Argentina, last sixteen. Mbappe is brought down in the box by Rojo. Penalty. Argentina fight back and lead. Then Pavard levels it. Sixty-fourth minute, Mbappe scores. Sixty-eighth minute, again. Four-two. Aguero pulls one back in stoppage time. Four-three. Messi, aged thirty-one, goes home. Mbappe, a teenager, goes on. Did a teenager really outplay Messi that day?
